newsitem.title: USA: Tuesday Morning Dec same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Tuesday Morning Dec same-store sales up.

text.p: Tuesday Morning Corp said Tuesday morning that comparable-store sales for the month of December 1996 were up 24 percent from December of 1995, adding that same-store sales were up 16 percent for the fourth quarter of 1996 compared to the same period in 1995.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, comparable-store sales increased 14 percent from 1995, Tuesday Morning said.
The company said in a release that the fourth-quarter sales event generated revenues of $118.2 million, a 26 percent gain over last year's $94.1 million in sales for the same quarter.
It added that sales for the year ended December 31, 1996, were up 22 percent to $256.8 million, compared to $210.3 million in 1995.
